summary: This is a Bokashicycle online store product page for Bokashi Culture Mix (wheat bran inoculated with microbes) sold in 400 g packets, with bulk pricing options. The description explains that the mix is a natural, chemical-free product that ferments food or pet waste into a soil-improving nutrient once oxygen is removed. Bokashicycle claims a shelf life over 5 years and says it is the world's largest volume producer of bokashi wheat bran.
one_line: Product page for Bokashicycle's Bokashi Culture Mix, a wheat bran microbial fermenting culture for converting food and pet waste into soil amendment.
key_facts: The product is Bokashi Culture Mix in 400 G (1 pound) packets, Part Number BCM12.
The 12 month supply option is priced at $58.99 and the item is listed as in stock.
Bokashi culture mix can be bought in bulk as 3, 6, 12 or 20 packets of 400 grams for best pricing.
Gardeners and farmers can buy 25# or 50# bulk packs for even greater savings.
Bokashi culture mix is sometimes called Bokashi Bran or Bran Mix.
Bokashicycle isolates naturally occurring microbes and fungi that rapidly metabolize organic (plant based) products.
The microbes are stabilized on wheat bran and remain dormant until activated by lowering and eliminating oxygen in the fermenting systems.
No chemicals or foreign materials are used in the process.
Kept dry and protected, the wheat bran culture mix has a shelf life of greater than 5 years.
Bokashicycle claims to be the world's largest volume producer of bokashi wheat bran.
Orders are delivered directly to the consumer by FedEx, and all on-line orders are filled on the day received.
The Bokashi Food Scrap Fermenting System is listed at $136.95 and the Bokashi Pet Cycle Yard Waste Accelerant Concentrate at $41.95 among top sellers.
